widgets_values:
# Herrgotts H3 Infinite v1.4 — Stitch Saved Chain (v1.4)

Use this after generating clips separately with the v1.4 Start / v1.4 Native Masked AV Continue workflows. It reads the manually numbered full AV latents and writes one final MP4.

### Normal use
1. Load the same Video VAE and Audio VAE used for generation.
2. Keep `latent_prefix = h3_continuous/clip` for the example Save nodes.
3. `first_clip = 1`; leave `last_clip = 0` to use the highest numbered clip.
4. v1.4 defaults: **Safe Tail Bridge 0**, 4-frame video blend, 15 ms audio de-click, luminance match OFF.
5. Queue. No H3 diffusion model or Qwen encoder is needed.

v1.4 saved continuation latents can contain audio protected beyond the 39f video handover. The stitcher removes the normal duplicate head while naturally retaining that useful extra audio tail.

nodes.title: INFO — Why this scales to long chains
widgets_values:
### Memory behavior
The stitcher does **not** decode every clip into one giant ComfyUI IMAGE batch. It processes one saved AV latent at a time, writes finished frames/audio directly into the output MP4, keeps only a tiny boundary buffer, then releases the decoded clip.

v1.4 defaults Safe Tail Bridge to **0**, so only the short video/audio crossfade buffers are normally required at each boundary. The legacy bridge option can still add a few frames when explicitly enabled for older guide chains. Peak RAM/VRAM therefore stays roughly tied to **one decoded H3 clip + the two VAEs**, rather than growing with 10, 20 or 50 clips. Disk usage still grows with saved latents and the final video.

nodes.title: INFO — Saved metadata / manual indexing
widgets_values:
### Self-describing saved clips
Each clip stores its full AV latent, its **actual reused Masked-AV head length**, and Auto Handover metadata.

Manual Save / Load indexing remains intentional in v1.4: `clip_00001`, `clip_00002`, ... You can still overwrite a chosen slot to regenerate a branch.

The stitcher also understands legacy v1.3 head/handover metadata, so old saved chains remain usable where their required metadata is present.

### Native Masked-AV seam alignment — v1.4
The previous visible **video** ends at the same safe AV-compatible boundary where the next clip's protected video context ends. That robust validated geometry is unchanged.

v1.4 does **not** attempt to reclaim video frames lost only to the AV-grid snap because live testing showed visible motion/alignment errors when original and regenerated trajectories were rejoined later.

Audio may extend independently beyond the video handover. Because that extra audio is stored inside the next full latent, removing the normal duplicate head leaves the valid carried dialogue tail in place automatically.

Safe Tail Bridge defaults to 0 and luminance matching stays OFF; both remain Advanced legacy/diagnostic fallbacks.
